g.text: Verified D5 and D16 transfer: daily mean of each arm's median forecast

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Daily mean of the day-ahead (24 to 48 h lead) median of each arm, mean over 2 seeds; shaded: the event. The normal running arrangement is the observed power minus the event; the arms are fitted on the observed power. The page's shares use half-hourly values, not these daily means.'
text.tspan: Daily mean of the day-ahead (24 to 48 h lead) median of each arm, mean over 2 seeds; shaded: the event.
The normal running arrangement is the observed power minus the event; the arms are fitted on the observed power. The page's shares use half-hourly values, not these daily means.
